QuestInfo.name: Weapon Acknowledges Its Owner
QuestInfo.0: As soon as you reach Level 200, #b#p1201002##k strikes up a conversation with you...?!
QuestInfo.1: #p1201002# tells you to come to #b#m140000000##k. He has something he wants to tell you.
QuestInfo.2: #p1201002# tells you that you are almost back to you old, heroic self, and as proof, gives you a powerful skill called Hero's Echo.

0.1: Finally! Just like the old times, I can talk to you directly. Now that you have the ability to hear me, there's only one more thing you'll need to learn...
0.2: Just come to #b#m140000000##k first. I'll give you the details once you get here.

1.0: We spent a few hundred years apart thanks to the Black Mage, and it was hard to recognize you when you first emerged from the ice. You weren't the hero I remembered; instead, you were just another person who couldn't even handle the #p1201001#. Worst of all, you didn't even remember me. Unforgivable.
1.1: But as time went by, you changed. You diligently leveled up, and I saw that you were trying your hardest to remember me. That's when I knew... You may have drastically changed, but you're still Aran. The old you is still inside.
1.2: You may have yet to retrieve all your memories, but your abilities are almost on par with your old self, I'd say. As proof, there's a skill that you can now use, and that's the reason why I brought you here.

yes.0: The skill's called #bHero's Echo#k. It's the perfect skill for someone with the role of the protector, which is exactly what you were when you faced the Black Mage. I want you to put that power to good use again, because its perfect for you.
